# Long March 10A liftoff before 2027: research notes

## 1. Resolution source
- No URL or data series is named in the criteria. The background link is a 2025-10-30 SpaceNews article about a 2026 target for the first Long March 10 launch. [SpaceNews](https://spacenews.com/china-targets-2026-for-first-long-march-10-launch-new-lunar-crew-spacecraft-flight/)
- The practical sources would be CMSA or Xinhua announcements and launch trackers. On 2026-11-11, NextSpaceflight shows the Long March 10A "Demo Flight" from Wenchang LC-301 as "NET 2026", carrying a prototype LEO Mengzhou. [NextSpaceflight](https://nextspaceflight.com/launches/details/8057/)
- Space Launch Schedule shows the date as TBD with a "projected December 2026" estimate, and lists no past 10A launches. [SLS](https://www.spacelaunchschedule.com/category/long-march-10a/)

## 2. Current status: there is a possible ambiguity that could settle this
- 2026-02-11, about 03:00 UTC: a rocket lifted off under its own power from Wenchang LC-301 on a suborbital flight. It was a low-altitude demonstration plus a max-dynamic-pressure abort test of Mengzhou. Official Xinhua coverage calls it a "长征十号" (Long March 10) test. [Xinhua](https://www.news.cn/tech/20260212/953c9239a6844c1990c5514942bc0919/c.html)
  - Cailian Press (cls.cn) explicitly named it "长征十号甲（CZ-10A）". It describes the rocket and spacecraft as prototypes (初样状态) and the vehicle as a single core stage. [CLS](https://www.cls.cn/detail/2286869)
  - English Wikipedia lists it as a "CZ-10A test" and the first 10A launch from LC-301. [Wikipedia LM-10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_March_10), [Wenchang](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wenchang_Space_Launch_Site)
- If the resolver counts that test vehicle as "a Long March 10A", the question may already be Yes. The fine print only requires leaving the mount under its own power, and gives no start date.
- If the question means the first full or orbital 10A flight, nothing has happened yet. I found no report of a 10A orbital launch through 2026-11-11. NewSpaceEconomy points out that the February test "did not mean that Long March 10A had completed an orbital launch." [NewSpaceEconomy](https://newspaceeconomy.ca/2026/05/11/mengzhou-1-and-long-march-10a-chinas-moon-rocket-and-capsule-prepare-for-first-flight/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-11-01: Andrew Jones posted that China is "in early stages of preparations to launch the first Long March 10A with the new Mengzhou crew spacecraft." I dated the post from its ID and could not open the full post (paywalled). [X/AJ_FI](https://x.com/AJ_FI/status/2116821262768976190)
- 2026-07-18: China in Space published "First Mengzhou Mission May Be Delayed to 2027". I only saw this through the Wikipedia citation. Wikipedia now lists Mengzhou-1, which would be the 10A's first orbital flight, as "scheduled for 2027". [Wikipedia Mengzhou 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mengzhou_1)
- The English Wikipedia launch table lists the first orbital 10A flight (10A-Y1, Mengzhou-1) as Q1 2027, but its lead section still says "late 2026". [Wikipedia LM-10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_March_10)
- 2026-07-10: The Long March 10B maiden flight from the Hainan commercial site was reported as a success with first-stage recovery. Chinese Wikipedia says it used a 10A-type first stage. I could not find an independent source to confirm this. [Wikipedia LM-10B](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_March_10B)
- 2026-05-22: China in Space said the 10A was expected to fly LEO proving missions "later this year." [China in Space](https://www.china-in-space.com/p/why-is-nasas-boss-saying-taikonauts)
- 2026-04: Asia Times, citing Chinastarmarket, said a combined 10A and Mengzhou test was likely "around November". [Asia Times](https://asiatimes.com/2026/04/us-china-space-race-shifts-into-a-higher-lunar-gear/)
- 2026-04-02: China in Space, citing STAR Market Daily, reported that the 10A debut had been moved up to mid-2026, carrying a Kinastra upper stage and a Space-Time Reference Satellite to lunar transfer orbit, with Mengzhou-1 in September. I found no evidence that either flight happened. [China in Space](https://www.china-in-space.com/p/long-march-10a-debut-moved-up-for)
- 2025-11-01: Xinhua and the CMSA plan said the 10A would debut in 2026, launching Mengzhou-1 uncrewed to Tiangong. [Chinanews](https://www.chinanews.com.cn/gn/2025/11-01/10508133.shtml)

## 4. Base rates
- The 10A's first orbital flight has slipped repeatedly. Reported targets went from "2026" to "mid-2026" to "September" to "around November" to "late 2026 / Q1 2027". None of those dates has been met so far.
- Chinese debut launches are rarely announced long in advance. Once a vehicle reaches Wenchang, the pre-launch campaign has typically lasted about 1 to 2 months. If the "early stages of preparations" report on about Nov 1 is accurate, a late-December launch would be tight but possible.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on the Long March 10A.
- None of the Kalshi markets supplied with this task match the question. The Minnesota and Idaho "10A" markets are state legislative districts, and the others cover Rocket Lab, Neutron, New Glenn and SpaceX HLS.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Watch for CMSA or Xinhua announcing that the 10A and Mengzhou-1 have been transferred to the pad at Wenchang LC-301.
- Watch for NOTAMs or navigation warnings near Wenchang, and for rollout or rehearsal reports from the Andrew Jones and China in Space trackers.
- The end-of-year CMSA schedule briefing could confirm a slip to 2027.
- How the question creator treats the February 11, 2026 suborbital "CZ-10A" test is the single biggest factor in how this resolves.

# Long March 10A: liftoff before 2027? Research notes

The first full Long March 10A has not launched, and the most recent reports point to early 2027. The open issue is the 11 Feb 2026 suborbital test: some sources call that vehicle a "Long March 10A", and it did lift off under its own power.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names no specific source. It only requires that a "Long March 10A completes a liftoff before 2027". In practice it will likely be settled by CMSA/Xinhua announcements and launch trackers.
- As of 2026-11-11, NextSpaceflight lists the 10A "Demo Flight" from Wenchang LC-301 as "NET 2026", status Planned. [NextSpaceflight](https://nextspaceflight.com/launches/details/8057/)
- Space Launch Now lists the 10A demo flight as "TBD December 2026", status To Be Determined. [Space Launch Now](https://spacelaunchnow.me/launch/long-march-10a-demo-flight)
- Rocketlaunch.org lists the 10A as Not Yet Launched. [rocketlaunch.org](https://rocketlaunch.org/launch-providers/china-aerospace-science-and-technology-corporation/long-march-10a)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-02-11: A "Long March 10 low-altitude demonstration" with a Mengzhou max-Q abort test lifted off from Wenchang LC-301 at 03:00 UTC. It reached about 105 km, and the first stage splashed down under control. Sources disagree on what to call the vehicle:
  - Chinese Wikipedia calls it a scaled-down, modified engine test vehicle and lists it as suborbital.
  - English Wikipedia's launch table and the Wenchang page list it as "CZ-10A".
  - China in Space headlined it "Long March 10A Test Booster".
  - **If the resolver counts this flight, the question is already Yes. If it requires the real two-stage 10A, it has not happened yet.** [zh.wikipedia](https://zh.wikipedia.org/zh-cn/%E9%95%BF%E5%BE%81%E5%8D%81%E5%8F%B7%E7%94%B2%E8%BF%90%E8%BD%BD%E7%81%AB%E7%AE%AD), [en.wikipedia Long March 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_March_10), [China in Space](https://www.china-in-space.com/p/long-march-10a-test-booster-flew)
- 2026-07-10: The Long March 10B made its first flight to orbit. It used a 10A-derived first stage, which was recovered by net. That was a 10B, not a 10A. [en.wikipedia Long March 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_March_10)
- I found no evidence that a full Long March 10A has flown to orbit.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-05: Universe Magazine, citing Ars Technica, says the 10A is "scheduled to send the new Mengzhou spacecraft into Earth orbit" without a crew in **early 2027**, and that the spacecraft is already at Wenchang. [Universe Magazine](https://universemagazine.com/en/china-announced-the-timelines-for-each-phase-of-its-crewed-lunar-program/)
- 2026-11-02: Ars Technica (Eric Berger) reported China's lunar plan slides, as cited on Wikipedia. Wikipedia now lists Mengzhou-1 as "2027 (planned)". [Mengzhou 1 wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mengzhou_1)
- About 2026-11-01: Andrew Jones posted that China is "in early stages of preparations to launch the first Long March 10A with the new Mengzhou." I could only see this through a search snippet, because X blocked access. [X/AJ_FI](https://x.com/AJ_FI/status/2116821262768976190)
- 2026-07-18: China in Space wrote that Mengzhou-1 will "probably" launch in the first few months of 2027. This is the author's inference, not an official statement. His reasons:
  - CMSA's plan for the second half of 2026 left out Mengzhou.
  - LC-301 was unfinished: no crew access platforms, the commodity tower was not at full height, and the assembly buildings were still being outfitted. [China in Space](https://www.china-in-space.com/p/first-mengzhou-mission-may-be-delayed)
- 2026-04-02: STAR Market Daily reported that the 10A debut had been moved up to mid-2026 and would carry a space-time reference satellite to the Moon using a Kinastra upper stage. I found no evidence that this flight happened. [China in Space](https://www.china-in-space.com/p/long-march-10a-debut-moved-up-for)
- 2025-11-01: CMSA officially planned Mengzhou-1 on the 10A's first flight in 2026. [Chinanews](https://www.chinanews.com.cn/gn/2025/11-01/10508133.shtml), [SpaceNews](https://spacenews.com/china-targets-2026-for-first-long-march-10-launch-new-lunar-crew-spacecraft-flight/)

## 4. Base rates
- First flights of new Chinese rockets usually slip by months past the year first announced. The 10A has already slipped:
  - The 2026 target was official.
  - The April 2026 report brought it forward to mid-2026, which did not happen.
  - Later reports moved it to "late 2026", then "Q1 2027 / early 2027".
- The Long March 10B, a sibling vehicle, did debut in 2026 (July).
- About 7 weeks remain. China usually announces crewed-program launches only days to weeks ahead, and rollout to the pad at Wenchang comes a few days before launch.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find a Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on the Long March 10A.
- The markets supplied with the question do not match it: Minnesota and Idaho "10A" are election races, and the others are Neutron, New Glenn and HLS. For comparison only, Kalshi prices New Glenn "before 2027" at 0.01 and Neutron at 0.04.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Watch for:
  - The 10A and Mengzhou-1 being moved to LC-301
  - Wet dress rehearsals
  - Airspace or maritime warnings (NOTAMs) for Wenchang
  - CMSA announcements
- Most recent reporting points to early 2027, but the spacecraft is reportedly already at Wenchang, and Space Launch Now still shows December 2026.
- Resolution ambiguity: whether the 11 Feb 2026 suborbital test counts as a Long March 10A liftoff. The resolver's interpretation may decide the question.
